name: patch_evidence_kind
description: Kind of base-versus-patch evidence carried for a fix. Defined once in remediation.schema.json and $ref'd by verification.schema.json, so a `proves` claim means the same thing on both sides of the fix. What each kind may legitimately conclude is bounded by the per-path evidence ceilings in the harness's docs/disposition-ledger.md §8a; a kind that claims more than its ceiling is a defect in the kind.
